alt: 即將臨盆的孕婦挺著明顯隆起的肚子，雙手輕輕托護腹部，伴侶在旁扶她走向座椅。
scene_prompt: 大腹便便 means having a conspicuously large protruding belly. A respectful contemporary family prenatal waiting area: an adult woman late in pregnancy is shown standing in clear three-quarter side view, her very large round pregnant belly prominent beneath a modest loose plain maternity dress. She places one hand gently on the top side of the belly and the other lower beneath it in a natural supportive pose; her partner at her side offers an arm calmly to help her toward a comfortable waiting chair. Both warm dignified smiles, not comedy or body shame. Unlettered prenatal leaflet with a simple mother-and-baby silhouette lies on side table; small potted plant, pale blue curtain, cozy clean clinic. Her belly must be recognizably an actual anatomical pregnancy shape connected correctly to torso, not a ball under a dress or bizarre swelling; two arms and two legs each, feet grounded, natural fingers. No medical needles, procedures, nudity, pain, comic sweat or exaggerated distortion. No writing, charts with labels, logos or readable letters.
